summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting its 2026 interim results, a routine financial disclosure for a foreign private issuer. The filing details first-half 2026 performance including a 23% increase in profit before tax to $19.5bn, revenue growth, and higher expected credit losses. Notable items referenced include a disposal loss on the planned sale of its Malta business and a completed UK life insurance sale, but these are ordinary business events embedded in earnings results, not the subject of the filing. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is announced in this excerpt.
